@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["Acme Holdings", "Smith & Co"])
def test_exports_for_accounts_with_reserved_characters(client, account):
    # Repeat so the request hits every edge node
    for _ in range(len(FakeApi.NODES)):
        exports = client.list_exports(account)
        assert exports and all(e.account == account for e in exports)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("account, expected", [("Acme Holdings", ["r-5"]), ("Smith & Co", ["r-6"])])
def test_reports_for_accounts_with_reserved_characters(client, api, account, expected):
    for _ in range(len(FakeApi.NODES)):
        reports = client.list_reports(account, since=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        assert [r.id for r in reports] == expected
    # Succeeds first time on every node, without leaning on the 400-retry
    assert len(api.requests) == len(FakeApi.NODES)


def test_search_query_is_encoded(client):
    assert [a.name for a in client.search_accounts("Smith & Co")] == ["Smith & Co"]
